stayType: Holiday park with caravans, lodges, glamping and beach houses
accommodation: Caravans (Saver to Signature Gold, mostly 2-3 bedrooms, sleep 4-8), Emerald Lodge (2 bed, sleeps 4), yurts (sleep 4-8), Geo Domes (2 bed, sleep 6), chalets (2 bed, sleep 6) and beach houses (3 bed, sleep 6, private hot tub).
suitableFor: Families, groups and dog owners wanting a full-facility park next to a big surf beach.
parking: Allocated parking with Gold caravans and the Emerald Lodge; Blue Badge spaces in the main complex.
beachAccess: Direct access to Perranporth Beach from the park, via a steep footpath through the dunes (not suitable for wheelchair users).
confirmedFeatures: Indoor heated pool with flume, seasonal outdoor pool and lazy river, surfing and bodyboarding activities, soft play, crazy golf, multi-sports court, supermarket, arcade, restaurants and takeaways
overview: Perran Sands is a large Haven holiday park set across 550 acres of dunes above Perranporth's three-mile beach. Stays range from caravans and chalets to yurts, geo domes and hot-tub beach houses, with pools, restaurants, a supermarket and children's activities on site.
surfTripFit: A path runs straight from the park down to Perranporth Beach, and surfing and bodyboarding are on the activity list, though the steep walk back up is worth knowing about.
gaps: Board/wetsuit storage not stated; unit numbers not stated.
